analysis_md:
由于混合偏导数在连续条件下与求导次序无关，可以先求 $\frac{\partial^2z}{\partial x\partial y}$，也可以先求 $\frac{\partial^2z}{\partial y\partial x}$。

方法一：先求 $\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}$，由复合函数求导法，

$\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}=f'\frac{\partial}{\partial x}(2x-y)+g_1'\frac{\partial}{\partial x}(x)+g_2'\frac{\partial}{\partial x}(xy)=2f'+g_1'+yg_2'$

再对 $y$ 求偏导，得

$\frac{\partial^2z}{\partial x\partial y}=\frac{\partial}{\partial y}(2f'+g_1'+yg_2')=2f''\frac{\partial}{\partial y}(2x-y)$

$+\left[g_{11}''\frac{\partial}{\partial y}(x)+g_{12}''\frac{\partial}{\partial y}(xy)\right]+\left[g_2'+yg_{21}''\frac{\partial}{\partial y}(x)+yg_{22}''\frac{\partial}{\partial y}(xy)\right]$

$=-2f''+g_{11}''\cdot0+xg_{12}''+g_2'+yg_{21}''\cdot0+xyg_{22}''$

$=-2f''+xg_{12}''+g_2'+xyg_{22}''$。因此选 B。

方法二：先求 $\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}$，$\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}=f'\frac{\partial}{\partial y}(2x-y)+g_1'\frac{\partial}{\partial y}(x)+g_2'\frac{\partial}{\partial y}(xy)=-f'+xg_2'$，

再对 $x$ 求偏导数，得 $\frac{\partial^2z}{\partial x\partial y}=\frac{\partial^2z}{\partial y\partial x}=\frac{\partial}{\partial x}(-f'+xg_2')$

$=-f''\frac{\partial}{\partial x}(2x-y)+g_2'+xg_{21}''\frac{\partial}{\partial x}(x)+xg_{22}''\frac{\partial}{\partial x}(xy)$

$=-2f''+g_2'+xg_{21}''+xyg_{22}''$。

【相关知识点】复合函数求导法则：若 $u=u(x,y)$ 和 $v=v(x,y)$ 在点 $(x,y)$ 处偏导数存在，函数 $z=f(u,v)$ 在对应点 $(u,v)$ 具有连续偏导数，则复合函数 $z=f[u(x,y),v(x,y)]$ 在点 $(x,y)$ 处的偏导数存在，且

$\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}=\frac{\partial f}{\partial u}\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}+\frac{\partial f}{\partial v}\frac{\partial v}{\partial x},\quad \frac{\partial z}{\partial y}=\frac{\partial f}{\partial u}\frac{\partial u}{\partial y}+\frac{\partial f}{\partial v}\frac{\partial v}{\partial y}$
